entries.positive_observation: Attempt 04 restores the strict left-facing single-eye profile with one green-ringed solid black eye, a high bald crown, short receding dark side/back hair and sideburn, one dark brow, clean-shaven chin and one serious closed mouth. The olive high-collared uniform retains two pale collar patches, one neck cross, shoulder braid and the visible note-clipped breast-decoration cluster. Collar contact is short and broad without a long neck or floating cloth. The pale backplate and complete photo frame remain, and the note has only two compact upper mark rows with no added circular pin. No visible interior alpha hole or lost backing appears on white or cyan.
entries.alpha_decision: visible-alpha-v1: reject for the source-incompatible note exterior, not for near-opacity. Internal alpha 252-254 is acceptable and no interior hole, smoke or lost backing is visible, but the returned RGB note and its native alpha silhouette both omit the source's small dark right-edge tab and substitute ragged/torn contours. The defect includes RGB art and cannot be corrected by alpha-only repair.
visible_limitations: A possible tiny eyewear/temple detail cannot be separated reliably from the exact 65x67 source shadow and is not a rejection ground.
Individual breast decorations, collar symbols and note glyphs are unreadable at source resolution; only their visible layout and counts were assessed.
remaining_reasons: Restore the source-visible small dark tab on the note's right edge at its original mid-height position and scale. Attempt 04 instead leaves only ragged/torn right-edge paper contours with no distinct tab. Correct the RGB note construction and its corresponding exterior alpha silhouette together while retaining the repaired strict single-eye profile, two compact note rows and absence of a pin.
